reviews.text: Had a customer want me to rescreen their frames. Most of them were beyond repair, and I have never done that task before. I just ordered all new from Affordable Screen Co. For the price, it just made sense. They looked great and seem to be good quality. Shipped quickly and safely. I will keep this contact for my next screen order!
reviews.author: Matt T

reviews.text: We are very happy with the screens we ordered to replace old wood frames ones on our porch.  Everything arrived packaged well and the screens fit perfectly.
reviews.author: Laurie Gunneson

reviews.text:
I ordered a custom size of Phifer Suntex 80 from this company and it definitely saved me a couple bucks compared to another screen mesh wholesaler and lot more than if I had bought from Lowe's or Home Depot.

I live in Florida and the shipment was pretty quick.

I'd say, if you also live in a warmer climate or perhaps the area you're trying to put the screens up faces south, I'd recommend the Suntex 80 or maybe even Suntex 90.

We just moved to this house and I replaced the screen on the top left. A little hard to tell but if you look at the light on the floor, the top light is more subdued than the bottom one, as that is not a solar screen.
reviews.author: Idyl Muyco-Ramirez

reviews.text:
I am very happy with my order from Affordable Screen Company.  I ordered screens of 3 different sizes.  A representative called me to clarify the hardware placement on the screens, which I greatly appreciated.  The screens were well packed and arrived in perfect condition, even though the box appeared to have literally been stepped on during its journey.
The screens look great and fit perfectly. Frames are all square and the screen material is neat and tight. The best part is that the price was half the cost of a company I had previously used. Affordable Screen will be my go-to folks from now on.
reviews.author: Tejas R

reviews.text: I have a front bay window with two side windows that open. These windows are less than a foot wide but over 60" tall. This made it a hassle to find customs screens at an affordable price. I searched for a few days and decided to pace an order with affordable. The quality of the screens I received exceeded my expectations by far. The screens were shipped in a custom crate as well to avoid any damage. Quality is in the details and this company provides just that!
reviews.author: Jonathon Nichols

reviews.text: Used them for the 1st time for sunscreen half circle shipped to Cali. The price was about 50% cheaper than local glass and screen shops also the packaging is the best I have seen and the product is 💯. Great customer service I had a question left a message and actually got a call back the same day. Just amazing!! Thank you and will be using you in the future.
reviews.author: K Singh

reviews.text: Couldn't believe the screen options and the descriptions were great ... you learn something new everyday. Did my measurement and ordered one because I wasn't sure the the frame would fit in my windows channels. Received it a few weeks (shipped to Maine), the packaging was very sturdy, bordering on overkill (but much appreciated). It fit perfectly so I ordered 8 more, these were shipped like the first. All told there were three different custom sizes and all of them fit like a glove. Wife has bird feeders and the betterview screen material exceeds her expectations for viewing. Measure more than once or better yet, if you still have them, pull your old screen frames and measure them. As for price these were half the price of other online companies and a third the price of getting them rescreened locally.
reviews.author: Thomas Markle

reviews.text: Matt took great care off us and was much faster than our previous screen guy
reviews.author: John Wilkinson
